decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently generate mana using artifacts, enabling the player to consistently play powerful spells early in the game. The deck includes cards like Mox Opal, Lotus Petal, and Urza's Saga to achieve this goal. It also utilizes disruptive elements such as Chalice of the Void and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck operates as an aggressive strategy, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast mana and powerful artifact spells.

The deck revolves around assembling the combo involving Cephalid Illusionist, Nomads en-Kor, and Thassa's Oracle to win the game instantly by milling the library and stacking Oracle's ETB trigger. It also includes cards like Narcomoeba and Grand Abolisher to protect the combo, along with disruption cards like Cabal Therapy. Aether Vial helps to cheat creatures into play, while Brainstorm and Ponder help with card selection. Additionally, the deck includes Teferi, Time Raveler to bounce potential threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The manabase is designed to support the combo while providing necessary colors for spells.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. It aims to put pressure on the opponent while also utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Aether Vial to efficiently put threats on the board. The inclusion of cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth further complicates the opponent's strategy, while Mother of Runes provides protection for key creatures. The deck also includes land destruction elements like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to disrupt the opponent's mana base and gain advantage.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive goblin creatures, using tribal synergy and efficient mana acceleration to quickly deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of powerful goblin lords, token generators, and powerful utility creatures, this deck aims to quickly build a board presence and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Aether Vial and Rishadan Port also adds a disruptive element to further disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing disruptive spells and efficient creatures to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It includes a mix of counter spells, removal, card draw, and powerful planeswalkers to outvalue the opponent and maintain control of the game. The main win conditions are using the powerful Hidetsugu Consumes All to deal damage to both players or leveraging card advantage with Brazen Borrower, Snapcaster Mage, and Hullbreacher. The deck aims to outsmart the opponent with careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The key idea behind this deck is to use lands to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using cards like Mox Diamond, Crop Rotation, and Life from the Loam, the player can effectively manipulate their land base to their advantage. The deck also includes cards like Punishing Fire and Exploration','','');">Valakut Exploration to deal damage and gain incremental advantage over time. With a mix of utility lands like The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale and powerful win conditions like Dark Depths, this control deck aims to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent in a game of resource management.

The deck focuses on using lands as a resource to control the game, utilizing cards like Crop Rotation, Life from the Loam, and Exploration to achieve this. It also includes Punishing Fire for removal and Exploration','','');">Valakut Exploration for additional card advantage. The deck can generate value through lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a powerful token through combo. It also includes utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Maze of Ith for disruption. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to dominate the game through land manipulation and control.

The main concept of this Merfolk aggro deck is to establish board presence quickly and disrupt the opponent's strategy with disruptive creatures like Merfolk Trickster and True-Name Nemesis. The deck aims to control the board with lords like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, while also utilizing utility lands like Wasteland and Cavern of Souls to gain advantage. The deck also includes disruption through counter spells like Force of Will and Daze, along with Chalice of the Void to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. Using Aether Vial for ramp and mana efficiency, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive Merfolk creatures.

This deck revolves around quickly establishing a board presence with powerful Merfolk creatures while disrupting the opponent's strategy with counter spells and land destruction. By utilizing cards like Aether Vial and Chalice of the Void, it aims to consistently apply pressure and control the game. The inclusion of True-Name Nemesis and Master of the Pearl Trident further solidify the deck's aggressive strategy, while cards like Brazen Borrower and Tide Shaper offer additional versatility and disruption options. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm and outmaneuver the opponent in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. It utilizes cards like Mystic Forge and Karn, the Great Creator to support the combo and control the board. The deck also includes various mana accelerants like Mox Opal and Grim Monolith to quickly set up the combo. Defense Grid and Relic of Progenitus are included to disrupt the opponent's strategies while cards like Aether Spellbomb provide utility. The deck aims to win quickly by efficiently implementing its combo strategy in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on cheating big creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Thassa's Oracle into play early through the card Show and Tell. It also utilizes Paradigm Shift to manipulate the library, Thought Lash to protect important cards from being drawn, and Sphinx of Foresight for card selection. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and win the game before the opponent can establish a solid board presence. The deck uses cards like Force of Will and Daze for disruption and protection, while also utilizing Lotus Petal for mana acceleration.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly set up and execute the "Show and Tell" combo, which allows the player to put powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, Griselbrand, or Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield without paying their mana cost. By using cards like Sneak Attack and Omniscience, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with giant creatures and quickly win the game. The deck also includes a variety of counter spells and cantrips to protect the combo and ensure consistency in executing the strategy.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana and cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul and Griselbrand into play using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with these powerful creatures before they have a chance to set up their own game plan. The deck includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces, as well as card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the combo pieces quickly. The deck is designed to win fast and decisively through its powerful combo potential.

The deck revolves around quickly putting powerful creatures into play through the use of card combinations like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Lotus Petal. By cheating out creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with massive threats early in the game. Counterspells like Force of Will and Daze help protect against opposing disruption, while cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder help dig for combo pieces. The deck's mana base is designed to support its fast, explosive plays, including lands like City of Traitors and Ancient Tomb.

This deck aims to generate a large amount of mana quickly using cards like Lotus Petal and Lion's Eye Diamond, paired with rituals like Cabal Ritual and Dark Ritual. The key strategy is to cast spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to set up a combo turn where the player can use Infernal Tutor to find and cast a win condition like Tendrils of Agony. The deck also includes cards like Wishclaw Talisman and Burning Wish to search for specific cards needed to win. The deck is resilient against disruption due to cards like Veil of Summer and Duress.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of powerful creatures and disruptive spells to maintain board control and apply pressure on the opponent. It includes versatile cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide, Force of Will, and Collected Company to keep the opponent on their toes. The deck also features a mix of high-value creatures like Leovold, Emissary of Trest and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath to generate card advantage and create threats on the battlefield. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature aggression and control elements.

This deck focused on quickly deploying threats and disrupting opponents' game plan with cheap, efficient spells. Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide early pressure, supported by counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Pyroblast while maintaining card advantage with cards like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration. Land disruption with Wasteland, along with cantrips like Ponder, helps ensure a smooth mana curve. Mystic Sanctuary offers additional utility by recurring key spells from the graveyard.

The main concept of this deck is to maintain pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures such as Murktide Regent and Delver of Secrets while disrupting their game plan with countermagic like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while also gaining card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. The mana base is streamlined to ensure consistent and timely access to all the necessary colors for the spells in the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combination of efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent alongside powerful spells such as Lightning Bolt and Force of Will to maintain control over the game tempo. By disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Daze and Wasteland and digging for key pieces with Brainstorm and Ponder, this Aggro UR Tempo deck aims to apply pressure quickly and efficiently while disrupting the opponent's plans to secure victory in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic like Force of Will and Daze. The deck uses cheap removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board and protect its threats. It also utilizes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the key pieces it needs for its aggressive game plan. The mana base is streamlined to ensure the deck can consistently hit its colors and cast its spells efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board while maintaining tempo through efficient removal spells and disruptive counter magic. By using cards like Lightning Bolt, Unholy Heat, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck can quickly apply pressure to the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. Additionally, the deck aims to filter through its library and find key cards with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration, allowing it to maintain momentum and adapt to different situations.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying efficient threats and disrupting opponents' game plans with countermagic and removal spells. It aims to apply pressure early in the game with cards like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, while also being able to protect its threats with cards like Force of Will and Daze. By maintaining tempo and controlling the board, this deck looks to overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize and take over the game. It leverages the power of efficient spells and versatile creatures to close out games quickly.
